# Scandit Developer Documentation

> Developer Guides, API References, and Code Samples for building with Scandit Smart Data Capture

This file contains links to documentation sections following the llmstxt.org standard.

## Table of Contents

- [Configuring Input Data](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/express/configuration/custom-data-transfer/input-configuration): Define the input fields Custom Data Transfer collects during scanning in Scandit Express, and set each field's type and format.
- [Configuring Output Data](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/express/configuration/custom-data-transfer/output-configuration): Configure how Custom Data Transfer structures, transforms, and exports scanned data to external systems in Scandit Express.
- [Custom Data Transfer](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/express/configuration/custom-data-transfer/overview): Import and export data in Scandit Express using a configurable CSV file or Google Sheet, aligning formats with your system without coding.
- [Bluetooth Device Pairing](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/express/configuration/device-pairing/bluetooth-pairing): Set up Bluetooth device pairing in Scandit Express to send scanned data from one device to another.
- [Device Pairing](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/express/configuration/device-pairing/device-pairing): Use Device Pairing in Scandit Express to transfer scanned barcode data in real time from a sender device to the receiver running your app.
- [Device Pairing for Web Apps](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/express/configuration/device-pairing/online-connection): Set up online device pairing in Scandit Express to send scanned data to a web application.
- [Find Items](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/express/configuration/express-find): Find Items in Scandit Express, powered by MatrixScan Find, speeds up picking by scanning many items and highlighting the right ones in AR.
- [ID Check](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/express/configuration/id-check): Scan and verify identity documents in Scandit Express to check age or validity for retail, hospitality, and regulated sales.
- [Available Configurations](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/express/configuration): Overview of the configuration options available in Scandit Express and how to set them up.
- [Inventory Count](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/express/configuration/inventory-count): Use the Inventory Count mode in Scandit Express for fast, accurate stock counting.
- [Scan Labels](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/express/configuration/scan-labels): Scan Labels in Scandit Express, powered by Smart Label Capture, reads multiple barcodes and printed text on a label in one scan.
- [Installation](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/express/getting-started/installation): Install Scandit Express on iOS or Android and activate it to add barcode scanning to any app.
- [Production Rollout](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/express/getting-started/rollout): Roll out Scandit Express to production with a mobile device management (MDM or EMM) system on Android or iOS.
- [Safari Browser Extension](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/express/getting-started/safari-extension): Integrate barcode scanning directly into Safari on iOS with the Scandit Express extension.
- [Scandit Express](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/express/overview): Scandit Express instantly adds barcode scanning to any existing app or tool on a smart device, with no code changes required.
- [Configuring the Markdown Workflow](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/express/workflows/markdown): Configure the Markdown workflow in Scandit Express to guide users through task-based work such as product recalls.
- [Built-in Workflows](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/express/workflows/overview): Scandit Express built-in workflows: configurable, ready-to-deploy modes that guide users with prompts and AR guidance.
- [Configuring the Task Management Workflow](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/express/workflows/task-management): Configure the Task Management workflow in Scandit Express to assign and track task-based scanning work.
- [Advanced Options](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/id-bolt/advanced): Advanced ID Bolt options for performance tuning and less-common integration scenarios.
- [API Overview](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/id-bolt/api-overview): Overview of the ID Bolt API, built around the IdBoltSession class that manages the full ID scanning journey from start to completion.
- [Callbacks](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/id-bolt/callbacks): Handle ID Bolt session completion and cancellation with callbacks so your app can respond to user actions and scan results.
- [Data Handling](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/id-bolt/data-handling): Control what data ID Bolt returns from scanned documents and how sensitive information is handled to balance functionality and privacy.
- [Document Selection](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/id-bolt/document-selection): Specify which document types ID Bolt accepts for scanning using the DocumentSelection class.
- [Getting Started](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/id-bolt/getting-started): Integrate ID Bolt into your existing app or website with minimal effort, often ready to test in your staging environment within an hour.
- [ID Bolt](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/id-bolt/overview): ID Bolt is a cloud-based identity scanning solution for fast, on-device ID scanning across desktop and mobile, improving experience and compliance.
- [Release Notes](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/id-bolt/release-notes): Release notes for ID Bolt: new features, changes, and fixes by date.
- [ID Bolt session](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/id-bolt/session): import {Redirect} from '@docusaurus/router';
- [Text Overrides](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/id-bolt/text-overrides): Customize the text ID Bolt displays in its user interface to match your branding or give users more specific instructions.
- [Theming](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/id-bolt/theming): Customize the ID Bolt visual appearance with the theme option to match your brand, including colors, dimensions, and other elements.
- [Validators](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/id-bolt/validators): Use ID Bolt validators to check scanned documents against your criteria, applied only to documents on the accepted list.
- [Workflow & Scanner Options](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/hosted/id-bolt/workflow): Customize the ID Bolt user-interface flow and scanning behavior to meet your requirements.
- [Supported ID Documents](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/id-documents): List of supported ID documents for ID Capture and ID Validate.
- [Installation](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/sdks/android/add-sdk): Add the Scandit Data Capture SDK to your Android project: dependencies, license key, and camera permissions.
- [Agent Skills](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/sdks/android/agent-skills): Install Scandit Agent Skills to integrate, debug, and customize the Data Capture SDK for Android from your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex).
- [AGENTS.md — Scandit Data Capture SDK (Android: Java/Kotlin)](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/sdks/android/agents-android): Agent guide to install and integrate the Scandit Data Capture SDK on Android (Kotlin/Java): SparkScan, MatrixScan, Label Capture, ID Capture.
- [Configure Barcode Symbologies](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/sdks/android/barcode-capture/configure-barcode-symbologies): Learn about the available symbologies and the corresponding configurations and extensions available.
- [Get Started](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/sdks/android/barcode-capture/get-started): Add Barcode Capture to your Android app: configure the mode, set up the camera and view, and handle scanned barcodes.
- [Barcode Generator](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/sdks/android/barcode-generator): Generate barcodes and QR codes in your Android app with the Scandit Data Capture SDK.
- [Get Started](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/sdks/android/barcode-selection/get-started): Add Barcode Selection to your Android app so users can tap or aim to select a single barcode among many.
- [About Barcode Selection](https://docs.scandit.com/data-capture-documentation/pr-preview/docs/sdks/android/barcode-selection/intro): Barcode Selection lets users tap or aim to pick one barcode among many in your Android app.
